sentences.en: "Was there a girl in the gym?" "Yes, there is."
sentences.zh: 体育馆里有女孩吗？“是的，有。”

sentences.en: I'm sorry, but I have to go to the gym.
sentences.zh: 对不起，但我得去健身房。

sentences.en: I got to know my current girlfriend at the gym.
sentences.zh: 我在健身房认识了现在的女朋友。

senses.zh: 〈非正〉健身房，体育馆 - 室内健身操；体操
